_comment: Copy this file, then put exactly three models from three families into models (see docs/panel-run.md). Each model rates each case twice: a blind phase without claims, then the checklist, so the estimate counts 2 calls per case and model. Claude/Anthropic, GPT/OpenAI and DeepSeek are refused. example_models is documentation only and never runs; check each id and its price on openrouter.ai/models before use.
